title: Who ran it
lede: Roles and dates come from Groupon’s filings and press releases. A later career is left out where we did not check a source.

people.name: Andrew Mason
people.text: Started The Point in 2007 and Groupon as “a side project” in October 2008.[^1] Took responsibility for the 2011 Super Bowl ads.[^22] Told staff on his last day: “As CEO, I am accountable.”[^24]

people.name: Eric Lefkofsky
people.role: Co-founder and chairman; interim co-chief executive from Feb 2013
people.text: Mason’s former employer, who “asked me to leave graduate school so we could start a business.”[^1] Joined the interim Office of the Chief Executive when Mason was removed.[^4]

people.name: Ted Leonsis
people.text: Shared the interim Office of the Chief Executive in 2013.[^4] As chairman in March 2023 he announced the appointment of Dusan Senkypl.[^15]

people.name: Rich Williams
people.text: Led the company when it took over LivingSocial and cut its footprint from 27 countries to 15.[^25][^7]

people.name: Kedar Deshpande
people.text: Stepped down as chief executive and director when the board appointed Senkypl, and stayed as an adviser for 60 days.[^15]

people.name: Dusan Senkypl
people.role: Interim chief executive from Mar 2023; chief executive from May 2024
people.text: Co-founder of Pale Fire Capital, which held nearly 22% of Groupon when he was appointed. A director since June 2022.[^15][^17]
